topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't help but think about what happened. I knew something wasn't quite right, but I never imagined it would be this. We’ve always trusted each other with the little things, and now to find out... Well, it’s shaken me. I wish I could have handled it better. Maybe if I had talked to them sooner, things wouldn’t feel so strained. It’s important to support them, but I also feel like we need to clear the air. I just hope we can find a way to move forward, to get back to how things were. It’s tough, knowing that trust is something that can break so easily, yet takes so much to rebuild.
